cues: A few careful turns release the tiny case screws beneath a laptop’s rubber feet.
Curtain brackets stay firmly mounted when their screws are driven into wall anchors.
The slotted fastener on a violin’s chinrest can be tightened to stop it shifting.
A smoke detector’s mounting plate comes free after its retaining screws are backed out.
Tiny screws secure the metal clasp on a wooden jewelry box during assembly.
A small threaded fastener holds a handheld game console’s casing shut until repair time.
